attack: Housing is a local-demand hit; it does not uniquely imply a global risk-off USD bid.
concession_trigger: A packet update that removes this remit's discrepancy or supplies the missing NZ official yields in a way that reverses the expression ranking.
defense: AUDUSD remains the residual cyclical expression after extreme duration is considered.
holes_in_opposing_case: Perma-bear treats AU housing as a completed AUD risk-off without showing that US activity/labor gauges have broken.

evidence_refs: rollup:Australian housing downturn deepens under higher rates
revised_trade.invalidation: Packet-updated evidence of a US activity/labor break or a fresh official AU hard-landing print.
revised_trade.mispricing: AUDUSD treats Australian housing and the Fed hike as a full risk-off reset while US activity/labor gauges remain warm and AUDUSD is only mid-to-upper 1y history.
revised_trade.thesis: Cyclical AUD still expresses under-discounted growth/risk continuity better than owning 98th-percentile global yields.
why_now: Frozen packet cutoff keeps the post-FOMC risk-reset and AU housing scare simultaneous.

unresolved_question: Whether the post-hike US front end and AU housing channel are one regime or two.
